mapper.select: select act.*, (act.total_num - act.stock_num) as receiveNum, IFNULL(count(cwo.activity_id), 0) as writeOffNum from activity act left join coupon_write_off cwo on act.id = cwo.activity_id where act.id=#{id} group by act.id

select act.id, act.name, act.type, act.amount_condition, act.discount_rate, act.discount_amount, act.distribute_start_time, act.distribute_end_time, act.status, act.total_num, act.stock_num from activity act where act.status=#{tabType}
